intro.text: The lower class of the Final Empire on Scadrial, who labour on noble plantations under taskmasters.
The lower class of the Final Empire on Scadrial, believed to descend from the people who did not back the Lord Ruler's rise to power.
One of the two peoples the Lord Ruler made when he altered mankind: shorter and hardier than the nobles, and able to have many children.

description.text: Nobles have spread tales that make skaa fear the evening mists: they believe anyone who goes out in them is killed and becomes a mistwraith.
Plantation skaa are treated worst of all, and die younger than city skaa, since those who can no longer work are killed.
Only very skilled skaa, like Clubs, can work a trade as craftsmen, and even they are underpaid and scorned by the nobility.
Every skaa Allomancer has noble blood somewhere in their ancestry.

items.text: In reshaping humanity to withstand the ash, the Lord Ruler gave the skaa a shorter, hardier build than the nobles and the ability to bear many children. These differences were small, and a millennium of interbreeding had mostly wiped them out.
